chunks: And in it that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, did not grant Satan authority over those who believe and are steadfast.
But He granted him authority over those of the believers who take him as an ally and disobey his command.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this teaching within the Shia doctrine of *al-Wilayah al-Takwiniyyah*, distinguishing between Satan's general authority over humanity and his specific dominion over those who consciously align with him through *khitab* (choice). This underscores the Shia emphasis on *ikhtiyar* (free will) as the mechanism by which believers can either submit to or resist spiritual influences, reinforcing the conditional nature of his sway.
